name: numi-lab
description: Guide Apple-native research workflows across the Numi Lab suite using each installed runtime and its own evidence.

interface.longDescription: Discover and run Apple-native research workflows across NumiVivo chemistry and molecular dynamics, NumiTissue, NumiBrain and NumanX, Numi Human biomechanics, Matter and NumiSolver physics, robotics, BirdFlow, and Numi Automata. The plugin routes your goal to the installed owner, checks inputs and existing artifacts, and reports measured results with their evidence limits. Local execution requires the relevant runtime and access to your Mac; installing this skills-only plugin does not install suite tools or connect ChatGPT on the web to your computer.
capabilities: Discover installed Numi tools and workflows
Inspect embodied brain and Human mechanics
Evaluate robot policies and retained evidence
defaultPrompt: Show the Numi tools available on this Mac and what I can run next.
Prepare a NumiVivo MD run from my existing system and verify its output.
Evaluate a Numi robot policy on held-out rollouts and report the physical outcomes.
